response.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID HAVING AVG(HGB) IS NOT NULL), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) AS overall FROM p), k AS (SELECT p.ID, p.avg_hgb, p.avg_hgb - o.overall AS above_overall FROM p, o WHERE p.avg_hgb > o.overall) SELECT ID, avg_hgb, above_overall, avg_hgb - (SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) FROM k) AS diff_from_kept_mean FROM k ORDER BY diff_from_kept_mean DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Patients whose HGB values are all NULL have no average and are excluded from both the overall mean and the kept set.
The overall average is the mean of per-patient averages over all patients with at least one non-null HGB, computed before filtering.
